figurative_meaning_en: Immature or young age, youthful in years
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাঁচা বয়সে সে অনেক ভুল করেছে।
তার কাঁচা বয়সের স্মৃতি এখনও তাজা।
example_sentences_in_english: He made many mistakes in his tender age.
Memories of her youthful immaturity are still fresh.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphor of 'kancha' (raw/unripe fruit) to describe early, undeveloped stages of life in Bengali culture.
